user.title: Choose manufacturer
user.description: Connect supported heating, ventilation and building controllers locally.

model.title: Choose controller model
model.description: Select the exact model and firmware. ✓ = built-in read-only point map or driver for the documented firmware. Other models need your own verified register map or BACnet/IP object discovery. EH-800B USB exposes its reviewed L1 controls automatically; other controllers require explicit write permission.

data.allow_writes: Allow reviewed writes for other models (EH-800B USB controls are separate)

register_map.title: Register map
register_map.description: Add a confirmed JSON map and turn off Discovery Mode to create measurement entities. Map addresses are one-based. Saving does not write to the controller.

data.profile_json: Modbus register map / BACnet object list (JSON)

research.title: Modbus research — read only
research.description: Try 1–8 comma-separated Unit IDs. Identification 43/14 needs no register address. FC03/04 requires an address from an identified source and its address base. Results never automatically become entities.

data.documented: The address comes from an identified document

ouflex_write.title: Ouflex — writable setpoint controls
ouflex_write.description: Select up to 64 documented numeric holding points and expose them as Home Assistant number controls. Only use on a physically isolated test controller, after independently verifying each selected point's Modbus write behavior, scaling and limits. Values are read back; a failed write triggers a best-effort restore. Clearing Enable disables all Ouflex writes.

data.ouflex_write_isolated: I confirm this Ouflex is physically disconnected from controlled equipment
data.ouflex_write_reviewed: I independently checked all selected points and their write limits

writes.title: Write permission
writes.description: Setpoint writes are off by default. Enable them only after confirming the values on the physical controller.

data.allow_writes: Enable reviewed setpoint writes (off by default; unknown points remain read-only)

error.invalid_research: Check Unit IDs, address base, count and confirmation of the address source.
error.entry_not_loaded: Load the integration before using the research tool.
